import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Convert body_mass_g (written as text, with commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # Drop out-of-range body_mass_g (e.g. 3700000, max allowed 6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    # Normalize sex label variants (e.g. 'FEMALE' -> 'female')
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    result = {}
    grouped = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    for sex, val in grouped.items():
        result[sex] = round(float(val), 2)
    return result
